1508716.steps: 1. Auth with FW with admin/password. 2. Use postman send GET ip helper setting:"https://{{ip}}/api/sonicos/ip-helper/settings". 3. Copy the response body and change the enable item to true. 4. Use this body to send PUT"https://{{ip}}/api/sonicos/ip-helper/settings". Then post pending "https://{{ip}}/api/sonicos/config/pending". 5. Get ip helper setting again check the response body.

2. Response body shows ip helper is disable. enable item shows false.
  5. Response body shows enable item as true.

1508719.steps:
IP-helper has some policies include DHCPv6. This policy also set Egress Interface.
  1. Auth to FW with admin/password using postman.
  2. Postman uses GET to check response body.
1508719.initial: Response body should contain all policies include DHCPv6 policy. Check DHCPv6 policy shows complete parameters such as destination has address or Egress Interface has right value.
1508719.title: Get ip helper's policies which include DHCPv6 policy and other policy.
1508719.result: Response body should contain all policies include DHCPv6 policy Check DHCPv6 policy shows complete parameters such as destination has address or Egress Interface has right value

1508721.steps: 1. Auth with FW using admin/password. 2. Postman use Get method to send API "https://{{ip}}/api/sonicos/ip-helper/protocols". 3. Check response body.
1508721.initial: Response body should contain all protocols and related values are right.
1508721.title: Get ip helper's protocols.
1508721.result: Response body should contain all protocols and related values are righ

1508722.steps: DHCP protocol is disable. 1. Auth to FW with admin/password using postman. 2. Get DHCP protocol. Edit in its response body, change enable to true. "enable": true, Use this body to send PUT "https://{{ip}}/api/sonicos/ip-helper/protocols".Then post pending "https://{{ip}}/api/sonicos/config/pending". 3. Get DHCP protocol again.
1508722.initial: In step3, get response shows DHCP protocol enable.
1508722.title: Put to enable DHCP protocol through command "/ip-helper/protocols"
1508722.result: get response shows DHCP protocol enable

1508723.steps: 1. Auth to FW with admin/password using postman. 2. Get DHCP protocol. Edit in its response body, change timeout to a different value. "timeout": "50", Use this body to send PUT for the specific protocol "https://{{ip}}/api/sonicos/ip-helper/protocols/name/DHCP".Then post pending "https://{{ip}}/api/sonicos/config/pending". 3. Get DHCP protocol again.
1508723.initial: In step3, get response shows DHCP protocol timeout to the changed value.
1508723.title: Put to change DHCP protocol timeout through command "/ip-helper/protocols/name/DHCP".
1508723.result: get response shows DHCP protocol timeout to the changed value

1508724.steps: 1. Auth to FW with admin/password using postman. 2. Get all protocols. Choose one protocol. Copy and edit in body, change name, port1 to an unused port, port2 as 0, timeout item removed and source_translation as true, raw set as false. If mode and ip can be changed, pls set it. Use this body to send POST "https://{{ip}}/api/sonicos/ip-helper/protocols". Then post pending "https://{{ip}}/api/sonicos/config/pending". 3. Get all protocols again.
1508724.initial: In step 3, response body shows timeout auto set as 30, other items same with the set value.
1508724.title: Post a new protocol with new port1 as a new port and port2 as 0, source_translation is true and raw set as false, mode Broadcast and no ip.
1508724.result: response body shows timeout auto set as 30, other items same with the set value
